name: 70. Forced tool choice capability flag (PR #6903 / #6887)
description:
tool_choice is gated by two independent capability questions, each datasheet-backed with a
name-based fallback (schemas.ModelCaps.ToolChoiceAnySupported / SupportsForcedToolChoice):

  1. WIRE DIALECT - does the endpoint accept the string "any"? Mistral and Fireworks do;
     every other OpenAI-compatible destination rejects it with
     "Invalid value: 'any'. Supported values are: 'none', 'auto', and 'required'." (#6887).
     The Anthropic integration emits "any", so OpenAI egress must respell it "required".

  2. MODEL CAPABILITY - can the model be forced at all? Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1
     removed forced tool use: tool_choice {"type":"any"} and {"type":"tool"} return
     400 'tool_choice: type "tool" and "any" are not supported for this model.'
     Bifrost drops the forced choice so the model answers under the default "auto";
     with the tool bound it still calls it. This covers the caller's tool_choice AND the
     synthetic bf_so_* structured-output pin Bifrost adds itself on Vertex/Azure/Mantle.

Controls matter as much as the regressions here: Fable 5 and Sonnet 4.6 must keep being
forced, or the gate is over-dropping and silently weakening every other model.

item.name: vertex/claude-fable-5-1 /v1/chat/completions synthetic structured output drops the pin - PR #6903

exec: // The synthetic bf_so_* pin is a forced tool choice Bifrost adds itself, so it needs
// the same gate as the caller's. Without it, structured output on Fable 5.1 over a
// provider that lacks native output_config.format returns the same 400.
// Account-scoped gating, not a product defect: Fable 5.1 on Vertex requires data
// sharing enabled for the anthropic publisher, and is absent from projects without
// it. Skip rather than fail so this case starts asserting once the project is set up.
var gated = /data.sharing|does not have access|was not found/i;
